    AI Overview
    The number 4 (four) is a natural number, an even integer, and the smallest composite number (
    ). It is a cardinal number, a digit, and a square number (
    222 squared
    ). In various cultures, it holds significance as a "complete" number (4 elements, seasons, directions), but is often considered unlucky in East Asian cultures due to the word sounding similar to "death". 
    Mathematical and Scientific Properties 
    • Geometry: A polygon with four sides and vertices is a quadrilateral.
    • Arithmetic:
      and
      . It is the second tetrahedral number.
    • Base Systems: The quaternary numeral system uses 4 as its base.
    • Measurement: A "four-finger" or quaternary structure is often recognized, such as the 4th power of a number. 
    Cultural and General Significance 
    • Symbolism: Often associated with balance, such as the four cardinal directions (North, South, East, West) or four seasons.
    • Religion: In the Bible, it is frequently used to indicate completeness.
    • Language: It is the only integer whose name has the same number of letters as its value.
    • Technology/Design: In digital displays, it is sometimes shown as a "Lego hand" shape to distinguish it from the number 9. 
    Other Uses 
    • Astronomy: 4 Vesta is a major asteroid.
    • Sports: In cricket, a "four" is a boundary score.
    • Medicine: The FOUR score is used to assess coma severity.
    • Psychology: The Enneagram personality type "Four" is known as the "Individualist".

    What is the number 4 in English?
    4 in words is written as Four. In both the International System of Numerals and the Indian System of Numerals, 4 is written as Four. The number 4 is a Cardinal Number as it could represent some quantity. For example, “there are 4 notebooks in that bag”.
